title: Europe First-Visit Trip Compiler — Duration, Theme & Pace
core_rule: A shorter trip is NOT the first N days of the 71-stop Grand Tour. The compiler selects a geographically coherent story with enough time to experience its 5-star anchors and relax between drives.

duration_scope_rules.3: One major city/base only. No inter-country driving unless the transfer itself is the subject.
duration_scope_rules.5: One city plus one nearby base/day-trip, or one compact scenic base. Maximum 2 lodging bases preferred.
duration_scope_rules.7: One coherent regional story; 2–3 bases maximum for relaxed self-drive.
duration_scope_rules.10: One corridor; normally 3–4 bases and at least one light/rest half-day.
duration_scope_rules.15: One major region; 5–7 bases maximum depending road complexity.
duration_scope_rules.21: One major region or two tightly connected regions; at least 2 recovery/light days.
duration_scope_rules.30: Multi-region trip, but preserve 2–4-night stays at major 5-star scenic bases.
duration_scope_rules.45: Large Europe arc. Skip lower-value transit nodes unless they protect the <=220-mile comfort rule.
duration_scope_rules.60: Broad Europe sampler with repeated 2–3-night city/scenic bases and weather buffers.
duration_scope_rules.90: Near-grand-tour; still prioritize quality over completing every route stop.
duration_scope_rules.120: Full relaxed reference Grand Tour using the approved 71-stop structure and flex nights.

traveler_modes.rule: Prefer editorial 5-star; add strongest 4-star only after core story and recovery needs are satisfied.
Allow 4-star neighborhoods, smaller museums, special architecture and alternate viewpoints before repeating every iconic 5-star.

pace_modes.rule: One major morning anchor + one afternoon anchor + optional evening. Late arrival is not a sightseeing day.
Up to two major anchors when no heavy drive/high-altitude activity occurs.
May add more 4-star stops, but never overrides safety, mountain weather, closures or ferry/border constraints.

load_model.rule: Relaxed mode usually keeps combined drive + sightseeing load <=7 and sightseeing-only load <=5.

hard_pacing_rules: No scheduled major timed attraction after a late arrival unless explicitly marked optional.
After a 181–220 mile transfer, default to one light city experience, not two museums.
After two consecutive high-load days, insert a light half-day or two-night base before the next high-load day.
Never schedule two separate high-alpine systems on the same day.
Weather-sensitive 5-star mountain bases keep flex capacity; ordinary city attractions cannot consume those flex days in advance.
Historic city cores use park-once + walk/transit unless the attraction itself is a scenic drive.
Border crossings add uncertainty and cannot be treated as zero-time map lines.
Barcelona→Civitavecchia remains a vehicle-ferry discontinuity and is never land-routed by the compiler.
Winter/late-autumn daylight is a resource: Rhine, Delphi, Meteora, Plitvice and mountain-road itineraries must end risky outdoor driving before dark where practical.

approved_short_products.summary_cn: Dutch Golden Age + Van Gogh + Anne Frank + canals；不需要租车在中心移动。
Castle→Charles Bridge→Old Town主轴 + Jewish Quarter/Vyšehrad轻松第二层。
Schönbrunn、Hofburg/inner city、KHM/St Stephen；不连续刷三宫。
Gaudí作为完整设计系统 + Gothic city core + 慢半天。
单基地避免搬酒店；Seceda、Passo Gardena/Alpe di Siusi、Braies，另留天气flex；Tre Cime仅条件好替换。
Lisbon 3慢日 + Sintra 1完整日 + coast/rest 1日。
Oslo文化入口→Flåm三视角峡湾→Geiranger水面/高处/公路；这是短版中最完整的Norway故事。
Dolomite石塔+金松→Engadin湖链+金松，必须保留天气弹性。
城市构图、河湾古镇、湖村和Baroque Alps；短距离但不换酒店竞速。
完整Alpine fall corridor；至少3个基地保留weather-flex选择权。
城市与峡湾平衡，Lillehammer/Karlstad是保护驾驶节奏的功能站，不强行升级成观光日。

long_product_strategy.21_days: Choose one deep region: Iberia complete, North/Fjords deep, or Central+Alps. Do not stitch three distant highlight clusters.
long_product_strategy.30_days: Choose 2 adjacent regional packs and preserve all 5-star multi-night scenic bases; prune 4-star transit sightseeing before pruning rest.
long_product_strategy.45_days: Choose 3–4 connected regions. Default target 70–80% of selected region 5-star content, not every route node.
long_product_strategy.60_days: Broad Europe sampler with major-city 2–3-night stays, mountain 3–4-night stays and recurring recovery days.
long_product_strategy.90_days: Near-full loop but compiler may skip low-value transit sightseeing and retain overnight-only nodes for driving comfort.
long_product_strategy.120_days: Reference relaxed Grand Tour: all 71 route nodes available, but sightseeing remains conditional by weather/energy/season.

compiler_output_contract: For every day output: sleep_base, drive_miles, estimated_drive_hours, border/ferry overhead if applicable, AM anchor, PM anchor, optional evening, rest logic, booking flags, weather fallback.
For every included POI output exact GPS and coordinate precision/source metadata.
Explain WHY a functional transit stop exists even if it has no 5-star attraction.
Always show what to delete first when tired: optional 4-star before 5-star, and sightseeing before unsafe late driving.
A relaxed itinerary may intentionally contain zero-attraction arrival or recovery days.
